messages.subject: Project Drake — first draft Subscription & Shareholders' Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver, Deepa,

Attached is our first draft of the Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement for Project Drake. Drafted on a company-favourable but balanced basis: 1x non-participating preference, broad-based weighted-average anti-dilution, standard consent matters, warranty cap at the investment amount, de minimis £25k / basket £200k, and a 12-month founder non-compete.

The Investor Rights Agreement and new Articles will follow this week. Look forward to your mark-up.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
